articles.summary: TORONTO, Feb. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Allied Gold Corporation (TSX: AAUC, NYSE: AAUC) (“Allied” or the “Company”) herein provides its preliminary operating results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2025, alongside the Company’s 2026 operating guidance and updates to its Mineral Reserves and Mineral Resources.
